chapter.verse: Mihonpite a muh ciangin Jesu mualtung ah kahto a, amah a tutsuk ciangin a kiangah a nungzuite hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in a kam ka a, nungzuite hih bangin hilhcian hi:
“Kha thu ah a zawngte thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen vantung kumpigam amaute' a ahi hi.
A dah a kap mite thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen amaute in hehnep ngah ding uh hi.
Lungnem mite thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen amaute in leitung luah ding uh hi.
Gilkial dangtak bangin dikna thu a lunggulh mite thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen amaute' lunggulhna kidip ding hi.
Thukhual mite thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen amaute in khualna ngah ding uh hi.
Lungsim siangtho mite thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen amaute in Pasian mu ding uh hi.
Nopna lemna a phuangte thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen amaute in Pasian' tate cihna ngah ding uh hi.
Diktatna thu hangin bawlsiat a thuak mite thuphangah ahi uh hi. A hang pen vantung kumpigam amaute' a ahi hi.
Keima' hangin midangte in note hong simmawhin hong bawlsia-in note' langkhat ah thusia namkim hong gen uh ciangin thuphangah na hi uh hi.
Vantung ah na ngah ding uh pahtakman a lianpi ahih manin nuamin lungdam un. A hang pen tua mite in note' ma-a kamsangte zong na bawlsia khin uh hi.

“Note pen leitung ci na hi uh hi. Ahih hangin ci pen a alna bei leh bangci bangin ki-alsakkik thei ding hiam? Kimanna nei nawnlo ahih manin paih ding leh mite' khe nuai-ah tuatcil a thuak ding longal thudang om lo hi.
“Note pen leitung khuavak na hi uh hi. Mualbo tunga kilam khuapi kiseel theilo hi.
Meivak a kivak ciangin zong beeltung peuh kikhuh lo hi. Meivaktau tungah kikoih a, tua meivak in inn sung bup khuavak taan hi.
Tua dan mahin mite in nahoih na septe uh mu-in vantunga om na Pa uh a phat nadingun mite' mai-ah na khuavak uh tangsak un.
“Thukhun Laibu ahihkeileh Kamsang Laibu suphiat dinga hong pai hong sa kha kei un; a suphiat ding hilo-in a cingsak dingin hong pai ka hizaw hi.
A hang pen maantak kong cihin ah vantung leh leitung a bei zongin Thukhun sunga thute a vekin a tangtun masiah laimal ‘i’ khat nangawn, lai a kikui ciau khat nangawn bei lo ding hi.

Tua hangin hih thupiakte a neupen khat palsatin midangte zong a tuaci dingin a hilhcian peuhpeuh vantung kumpigam ah a neupen kici ding a, ahi zongin tuate zui-in a hilhkhia peuhpeuh vantung kumpigam ah milian kici ding hi.
A hang pen ke'n kong cihin ah dikna thu ah laisiamte leh Pharisee-te sangin na cingtaakzawk kei uhleh vantung kumpigam na lut kei ding uh hi.
“Tanglai mite' kianga kigen, ‘Tualthat kei in; tualthat peuhpeuh thukhenna tuakkha ding hi,’ cih thu na za khin uh hi.

Ke'n kong cihin ah a sanggampa' tungah a heh peuhpeuh thukhenna tuak thei ding hi. A sanggampa a simmawh peuhpeuh Sanhedrin kitun thei ding a, ‘Nang mihai!’ a ci peuhpeuh hell meili sung kipuak thei ding hi.
Tua hi a, biakpiaktau mai-ah biakpiak van na luui laitak nang' tungah na sanggampa lungkim lo cih na phawkleh
biakpiaktau mai-ah na biakpiak van nusia phot inla na sanggampa' kiangah pai-in kilemtuah masa in. Tua ciangin hong pai-in na biakpiak van luui in.

Na thulangpa tawh thukhen zum na paikhop laitak a manlangin kilemna bawl in. Tua hikeileh na thulangpa in thukhen mangpa' kiangah nang hong ap ding a, thukhen mangpa in zum nasempa' kiangah nang hong apin thong na kia ding hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah quadran khat zong siit lo-in liausum na khitsiang mateng na suakta ngeikei ding hi.
“‘Nulepa angkawm kei in,’ ci-a kigen thu na za khin uh hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah numei khat cilesa lunggulhna tawh a ente khempeuh a lungsim sungah tua numei tawh angkawm khinzo hi.
Na taklam mit in nang hong khialsak ahihleh khelkhia inla paai in. A hang pen na pumpi bup hell sung hong kikhiatsuk ding sangin na pumpi na khat na neihloh hoihzaw hi.
Tua hi a, na taklam khut in nang hong khialsak ahihleh satkhia inla paai in. A hang pen na pumpi bup hell sung a tun ding sangin na pumpi na khat na neihloh hoihzaw hi.
“‘A zi a ma peuhpeuh in a zi' tungah makna lai pia ta hen,’ cih zong kigen hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n kong cihin ah nulepa tatkhialhna thu hang lobuang a zi a mate khempeuh in a zi angkawm a suaksak hi a, a kima numei a tenpih peuhpeuh angkawm ahi hi.
“Tanglai mite' tunga kigen, ‘Kiciamkhial kei inla, Topa' tungah na kiciam bangun na sem ding hi,’ cih thu na za khin uh hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n kong cihin ah: Kiciamna zang vet kei un. Vantung tawh hileh tua pen Pasian' kumpi-tokhom ahi hi.
Leitung tawh hileh tua pen Pasian' khe-ngakna tokhom ahi hi. Jerusalem tawh hileh Kumpi lianpa' khuapi ahi hi.
Na lutang uh tawh zong kiciam kei un; a hang pen na samzang uh khat nangawn a vom a kang ding na bawl thei kei uh hi.
Na gen uh thu pen ‘Hi,’ ahihkeileh ‘Hilo,’ cih ciang hisak lel un. Tua khengval-a genna peuhmah Gilo' kiangpan hong pai ahi hi.
“‘Mittang khat taangin mittang khat, hatang khat taangin hatang khat,’ ci-a kigen thu na za khin uh hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n note kong cihin ah: A gilo mi, langdo kei un. Mi khatpeuh in na taklam paang hong bet leh a langkhat zong na dawh in.
Mi khatpeuh in thu hong bawl nuamin na puantual sungsilh hong laksak sawm leh na puantual tungsilh uh zong lasak in.
Mi khatpeuh in zawhthawh thu tawh tai khat pai ding hong sawl leh amah tawh tai nih pai in.
Nang' kianga hong ngente pia inla, nang' kiangpan hong leitawite nolh kei un.
“‘Na vengte it inla, na galte mudah in,’ ci-a kigen thu na za khin uh hi.
Ahih hangin ke'n kong cihin ah: Na galte uh it unla, no hong bawlsiate' ading thungen un.
Tua pen vantunga om na Pa uh' tate na suah nading uh ahi hi. A hang pen amah in mihoihte leh mihoihlote' tungah a kibangin ama' ni suaksak a, midikte leh midiklote' tungah a kibangin guah zusak hi.
A hang pen no hong itte bek na it uhleh bang pahtakman ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Tua ciang buang siahdongte nangawn hizo uh hilo ahi hiam?
Na sanggamte uh bek na hopih uhleh midangte sangin na sepzawk uh bang om ahi hiam? Tua ciang buang Gentile mite nangawn hizo uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, vantunga na Pa uh cingtaak ahih mah bangin note zong na cingtaak un.
